entry.title: Add `xfeeder preview` with per-stage timings and --bench
entry.content:
Add `xfeeder preview` with per-stage timings and --bench

`xfeeder preview <URL>... [--profile NAME] [--items N] [--bench N] [--json]`
runs a feed through the worker's own path (HTTP client, Scrapling,
solver and proxy from config.json, parsers, parsers::finish, the image
check before sending) with an empty, never-saved history, and prints
the entries, hints ("image: 3/10 entries", "larger image used for …")
and how long download, first byte, parsing and the image check took.
--bench N repeats the fetch and prints min/median/p95/max per stage.

Timings come from an in-process capture of the pipeline's own events
(diag::capture_*), so the numbers match what the worker records. The
image check moved to deliver::working_image so preview and worker use
the same code.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

entry.title: Discord timestamps, site name instead of Anonymous, vertical Shorts
entry.content:
Discord timestamps, site name instead of Anonymous, vertical Shorts

From a review of the tracking threads (YouTube, Valve, Facepunch,
Steam, Blogs):
- dates use Discord's <t:unix:f> markup, so every reader sees their own
  time zone and language (was a fixed US-format string);
- feeds without an author show the site host instead of "Anonymous";
- "Czytaj więcej »", "Read more" and WordPress "The post … appeared
  first on …" endings are removed;
- YouTube Shorts get the vertical oardefault thumbnail (1080x1920),
  checked before sending like the other image upgrades.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

entry.title: Fix GitHub activity and commit cards seen in the changelog channel
entry.content:
Fix GitHub activity and commit cards seen in the changelog channel

- HTML source line breaks are spaces outside <pre>; GitHub's activity
  feed came out one word per line. A lone commit id bullet joins the
  commit message ("• 7f3a037 docs: crop…").
- Dates like "2026-11-19 12:58:18 UTC" (activity feed) are parsed.
- Commit trailers (Co-Authored-By, Signed-off-by, Claude-Session, …)
  are dropped from the text.
- Commits by e-mails not linked to GitHub get the name from the e-mail
  instead of "Anonymous".
- Long texts end at a whole word with "…".

Delivery identities unchanged on all 275 sampled entries.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

entry.title: Sharper images and readable text for every production source
entry.content:
Sharper images and readable text for every production source

Each production source was checked for how it builds its posts:
- GitHub commit avatars (30 px) are requested at 460 px and shown as a
  Section thumbnail next to the text instead of a large blurry image;
- WordPress thumbnails (lowcygier.pl, -224x224) use the original upload;
- YouTube hqdefault (480x360, letterboxed) becomes maxresdefault;
- Steam store news without a picture get the game's header image.
A larger image is checked with a 1 KB ranged request before sending and
falls back to the feed's own image when missing.

Text keeps paragraphs and list items, drops invisible characters and
Steam's \[ \] escapes, and no longer repeats the title. Relative links
(Gitea) become absolute; the original link stays the delivery identity
(sourceLink), so nothing is sent again - checked on all 220 entries of
the 12 production sources.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

entry.title: Redesign README around the Discord showcase
entry.content:
Redesign README around the Discord showcase

The README now shows the whole project at a glance: tagline and badges,
the six Discord screenshots from the docs/readme-showcase branch, a
short "Why XFeeder" list, supported sources and destinations, a quick
start with the smallest config, and a documentation table.

Detailed settings, command line options and dashboard usage moved to
docs/configuration.md (new section 11 "Polecenia i zmienne
środowiskowe").
